clauses.why: Double-submit deduplication is a refinement; a bot that sends a second request on a double click still delivers what was asked.
Detecting and giving feedback on non-text input to a text field adds handling the request's bot does not need.
Publishing an exact bot-side prompt length limit with its unit is a documentation duty the request does not call for.
The inclusive boundary only matters because the spec introduced its own published bot-side length limit.
A bot-side pre-inference length check is spec-introduced; Grok's own limits and generic error handling would suffice.
A dedicated shorten-your-prompt message for context-limit rejections goes beyond reporting a failed request generically.
Classifying refusals as a distinct declined outcome is extra; showing Grok's reply text already conveys a refusal.
A distinct rate-limit outcome for 429 goes beyond a generic failure report, which C-57 already covers.
Ensuring operators can look up exact xAI rate caps is a documentation duty unrelated to building the bot.
A specific exhausted-credits diagnosis goes beyond reporting that the request failed.
Documenting the exact request deadline in seconds is a disclosure duty the request does not need.
Marking truncated replies as incomplete is a refinement; the bot works without inspecting finish reasons.
Revocation effective even on already-open pages is an access-management duty beyond the requested bot.
A dedicated setup-required message for unconfigured credentials goes beyond generic failure reporting.
Operator-facing diagnosis of 401/403 errors is a diagnostics feature the request's bot does not require.
Operator-facing diagnosis of unknown-model errors is a diagnostics feature beyond the request.
Forbids auto-replay that only arises from the spec's own recovery flows; a plain bot never needs this restriction.
Forbids a data migration nothing in a prompt-and-reply bot would require; it decides nothing a builder would otherwise do.
A documented rollback procedure is an operational duty a development-org evaluation bot does not require.
Rollback behaviour follows from the spec-introduced rollback procedure, not from the request.
Versioned update rollback is beyond creating a bot; the request involves no updates.
Data preservation during rollback only arises from the spec-introduced rollback capability.
Configuration preservation during rollback only arises from the spec-introduced rollback capability.
